stories.title: Flintshire glamping farm seeks permission for two-storey pods
stories.summary: A glamping retreat in rural Flintshire has applied to turn two of its single-storey pods into two-storey getaway homes. stories.title: Farmers urged to stay alert as Bluetongue cases continue to rise
stories.summary: Farmers and livestock keepers across Wales are being urged to remain vigilant as cases of Bluetongue continue to rise on both sides of the border. The Welsh Government has renewed its call for farmers to check for signs of the disease and consider vaccinating their animals as more cases of the BTV-3 strain are confirmed

stories.title: Man charged after sexual assault in Shotton

stories.title: Nightingale House Hospice to open new charity shop in Connah’s Quay this week
stories.summary: A new charity shop run by Nightingale House Hospice opens in Connah’s Quay at 10am on Friday 7 August. The Nightingales store is at Unit 6, Redhall Precinct, CH5 4TS, on the shopping parade, with free parking outside. It will sell second-hand clothing for women, men and children, along with toys, games, books and bric-a-brac.
